# Civics — synthetic fixture for testing

civic_agrarian_idyll = {
	name = civic_agrarian_idyll
	description = civic_agrarian_idyll_desc

	playable = { always = yes }

	potential = {
		authority = {
			OR = {
				value = auth_democratic
				value = auth_oligarchic
			}
		}
		ethics = {
			NOT = { value = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		planet_farmers_food_produces_mult = 0.10
		planet_farmers_upkeep_mult = -0.10
	}

	ai_weight = {
		weight = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 2.0
			has_tradition = tr_expansion_finish
		}
	}
}

civic_beacon_of_liberty = {
	name = civic_beacon_of_liberty
	description = civic_beacon_of_liberty_desc

	playable = { always = yes }

	potential = {
		authority = {
			value = auth_democratic
		}
		ethics = {
			NOT = { value = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		pop_government_ethic_attraction = 0.25
		country_unity_produces_mult = 0.10
	}

	ai_weight = {
		weight = 1
	}
}

civic_distinguished_admiralty = {
	name = civic_distinguished_admiralty
	description = civic_distinguished_admiralty_desc

	playable = { always = yes }

	potential = {
		ethics = {
			OR = {
				value = ethic_militarist
				value = ethic_fanatic_militarist
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		ship_fire_rate_mult = 0.05
		naval_cap_from_planets_mult = 0.10
	}

	ai_weight = {
		weight = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 2.0
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_militarist
		}
	}
}
